column1: # The SECURED cluster's stopped consumer groups.
# Two groups, which is the fewest that proves anything. Consumer-group lag is computed by
# comparing a group's committed offsets against a topic's end offsets — two separate calls to the
# broker, either of which could be the one that fails over a secured connection. A single group
# whose lag happened to be zero would not tell you whether the numbers were being read at all or
# whether both were coming back empty.
# So: one behind and one caught up. If the screen shows 8 and 0 rather than 0 and 0, both calls
# Caught up: committed at the end of every partition, lag zero.
